def points_of(cls):
    pat = re.compile(bldg + r'([A-Za-z0-9_\.]+)\s+a ' + brick + cls + r'(?![A-Za-z0-9_])')
    return list(set(m.group(1) for m in pat.finditer(ttl)))

def ispointof(pts):
    out = {}
    for p in pts:
        pat = re.compile(re.escape(bldg+p) + r'\s+.*?' + brick + r'isPointOf\s+' + bldg + r'([A-Za-z0-9_\.]+)')
        m = pat.search(ttl)
        if m:
            out[p] = m.group(1)
    return out
